notes.title: OMNIFATE Update 1.10.1.1 Release
notes.content: [p]Hey all,[/p][p][/p][p]OMNIFATE has been updated to version 1.10.1.1. notes.title: OMNIFATE Update 1.10.1.0 Release
notes.content: [p]Hey all. Wow, it's been a long time, huh? Over a year (and close to a year and a half) since the last update . . . well, I've got a pretty sizable one to release before I head off fully working on my latest project, Deathplane, which you can wishlist on Steam right now.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the patch notes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Navigation[/b][/p][p]Movement speed has been increased significantly.[/p][p]Changed the layout of several rooms in the game. In general, rooms where you can no longer head south have the ground cut off towards the southernmost end.[/p][p]Added a new secret, and added new content to certain secrets.[/p][p]Once again, changed the way you enter a certain secret room.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where holding left on the D-Pad on an Xbox controller or certain Nintendo controllers would move you at double speed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dialogue[/b][/p][p]A lot of dialogue in Trewfolk Town has been rewritten, and a lot of dialogue and tone that I didn't really appreciate after a year's worth of retrospective has been removed or rewritten. Yukina has once again been given the most major hit in this regard.[/p][p][/p][p]Attempted to fix most issues where dialogue boxes would overflow beyond the edge of the screen.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Art[/b][/p][p]The font has been updated, with the biggest changes being the capital "E" and "S". Logos in-game have been updated to reflect this.[/p][p][/p][p]Updated Yukina's overworld design.[/p][p][/p][p]Updated the diary's design at the beginning of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Changed the water texture.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Menus[/b][/p][p]Menus can now be controlled with the Left Stick.[/p][p]You can no longer save in Ardent's arcade or the room leading up to it. This caused several issues, and you can already save in the room right below.[/p][p]You no longer have to hold the menu button to access the in-game menu. Pressing the menu button will now enable the menu. Pressing the menu button again afterwards will now close it. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/p][p]Other miscellaneous changes and improvements.[/p][p]Updated the copyright info.[/p][p]Removed RF Generation from the intro credits.[/p][p]Updated the end credits.[/p][p][/p][p]I know that I said that this update would have Steam Input support, but that unfortunately proved to be too difficult to implement. [/p][p][/p][p]As previously stated, this will be my last content update before I move onto Deathplane, so see you guys.[/p][p][/p][p](I will still be doing bug fixes for any that get reported to me.)[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: OMNIFATE is 60% off for the Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest!
notes.content:
The awesome folks at Valve extended the invitation to join the Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest all the way to yours truly.

I have no idea how this happened. Nobody has even heard of this silly little 15-minute turn-based RPG.

Regardless, OMNIFATE is on sale through the entirety of the Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest (September 30 - October 7), for 60% off, which also brings the price of the game down to 60 cents (its lowest price yet!). Math

If you've never given OMNIFATE a try because of its price, [[NOW'S YOUR CHANCE]].

Also, here's my obligatory friendly reminder that a relatively big update is coming, so look forward to that, and i dont know planes or something

Additionally, while you're here, try some other turn-based RPGs, will ya? They're my favorite genre of video games, and if done well, can be a great source of fun. I think the genre has given us some of the best stories in video games, as well. I'm not saying that OMNIFATE goes up to that level or anything, but there's lots of good ones.

This is unrelated to OMNIFATE, but can I just say that I love the fact that Steam is doing a Turn-based RPG Fest this year? Turn-based RPGs get so much hate now. Everybody calls them too traditional, or say that they don't have enough action, but personally, I've always loved the genre.

Lastly, another huge thanks to Valve for letting OMNIFATE join this Fest. It was very much appreciated, and I hope that I can do it again someday.

notes.title: OMNIFATE is one year old, as of today!
notes.content:
On this day, one year ago, something very special happened.

I released my first video game.

Happy anniversary, OMNIFATE!

Unfortunately, I don't really have anything big to announce today. No c'Raig Sweepstakes, no new chapters of OMNIFATE 2, ([i]unconfirmed[/i]) or anything like that.

I did have an update and a sale planned, but unfortunately, life has been rather hectic for me lately, so I was not able to get either set up in time.

 If you are interested in a sale, though, a special something related to a sale might be coming soon... hmmm

Although I don't have anything big to announce today, I do have some things!

You may have noticed I said "first video game." "First" would imply multiple, right?

Yes, that is correct. More games are coming!

I won't be revealing any details about them right now, as I have to focus on school, but the one I am currently working on has had more total development time than the RPG version of OMNIFATE, with lots of QoL stuff added and will overall be a fun experience, I think.

A lot of this has been backported to OMNIFATE, but not all. Little secret: most of the additions of the 1.10.0.x updates were features added during development of this new game, backported to OMNIFATE, and obviously going back and fixing buggy things.

You may want the new games right now. Unfortunately, game development takes time, and I'm not prepared to share any more details right now, as I don't want to repeat the same mistakes I made during initial development of OMNIFATE.

With that said, I haven't given up platformers forever, and has anyone noticed my media outlets have been saying "plane" a lot recently?

As for the OMNIFATE side of its anniversary: I have two things to announce.

1) OMNIFATE will be receiving a content update sometime. Not sure when because of how busy I've been lately, but it will be coming someday. It will fix some bugs I've noticed, add even more QoL stuff, native Steam API support including Steam Input, and something else...

2) ...localization...? I can't say what language just yet, as there's a lot of things still going on behind-the-scenes for it. I know what you're thinking; it won't be Japanese.

With that said, thank you for enjoying the game. Here's to another year, another decade, and maybe even a century of OMNIFATE, if Steam survives till then.

notes.title: OMNIFATE Update 1.10.0.6 Release
notes.content:
OMNIFATE version 1.10.0.6 has been released. This update fixes a bug reported to me the other day and makes some minor changes to the font.

Navigation:

- Fixed a crash that could occur in a certain room in Cerulea. Thanks you, Cuubluu, for reporting this issue.

Dialogue:

- Redrew the "6" in the font used in the game. I've never been really proud of it, and now that this is version 1.10.0.6, I figured it would be a good time to redraw it.

- Fixed an issue where the redrawn square brackets ( [] ) introduced in 1.10.0.0 were inconsistent in spacing.

notes.title: OMNIFATE Update 1.10.0.5 Release
notes.content:
Hey all,

OMNIFATE version 1.10.0.5 has been released. Yes, I have made a new update every two days four times in a row now. Have fun with that.

This update contains a sole bug fix:

Navigation:

- Fixed an issue found in 1.10.0.4 where the arcade in Ardent would not render properly.

notes.title: OMNIFATE Update 1.10.0.4 Release
notes.content:
OMNIFATE version 1.10.0.4 has been released. This is a minor update, but it fixes a longstanding issue as well as fixing an issue found in 1.10.0.3.

Dialogue:

- The first line of dialogue in a set is no longer automatically fully displayed as soon as you start the conversation.

- The new gamepad system should now actually handle dialogue correctly.

notes.title: OMNIFATE Update 1.10.0.3 Release
notes.content:
OMNIFATE version 1.10.0.3 has been released. This update mainly fixes some issues found in the new control system.

Dialogue:

- Fixed an issue where having a gamepad and a keyboard connected at the same time would not allow you to advance to the next dialogue box when playing with the keyboard.

- Fixed an issue where dialogue was not added to one of the things in one of the secret rooms, thus resulting in a crash.

Menus:

- Fixed an issue where having a gamepad and a keyboard connected at the same time would not allow you to open or use the menu when playing with a keyboard.

notes.title: OMNIFATE Update 1.10.0.2 Release
notes.content:
OMNIFATE version 1.10.0.2 has been released. This update mostly focuses on gamepad support.

Gamepad:

- Added support for gamepads during a certain secret, and updated said secret to have a button prompt for gamepads.

- Significantly reworked how the controls work underlyingly. This change makes it so that any combination of keyboard, Nintendo controller, and Xbox controller should work simultaneously, allowing you to play the game with a keyboard when a controller is also plugged in, or vice versa. Additionally, the WASD keys can now also be used to move the character when playing with a keyboard.

Dialogue:

- Updated a line of dialogue to coincide with the new ability to use the WASD keys to move.

- Added a secret that has something to do with ringing and bluu.

Menus:

- Updated the sound test/music player menu. (Specifically, the menu is now separated into two pages, and the songs from 1.10.0.0 update have been added.)

notes.title: OMNIFATE Update 1.10.0.1 Release
notes.content:
Hey all,

OMNIFATE has been updated to version 1.10.0.1. This update fixes a couple of issues I found with 1.10.0.0 post-launch.

Navigation

- Fixed an issue where some areas in a secret room weren't acting correctly.
- Fixed an issue where some new music added in 1.10.0.0 would still play even when music was turned off.
- Changed the layout of the room to the east of the arcade in Ardent, fixed a bug there, and added a small secret in that room.


 Dialogue

- Fixed an issue where a certain NPC integral to 1.10.0.0's dialogue was acting inconsistent and sometimes crashing the game.


Menus

- Fixed an issue where you could open the menus during some parts of a secret sequence of events in which you shouldn't have been able to open the menu.

notes.title: OMNIFATE Update 1.10.0.0 Release
notes.content:
----[b]NOTE: SAVE FILES FROM PREVIOUS VERSIONS ARE INCOMPATIBLE WITH THIS UPDATE AND WILL NEED TO BE DELETED.[/b]----  

(The reason I'm ok with this is it's a 15-minute game.)

OMNIFATE has been updated to version 1.10.0.0. This is definitely the biggest update so far, and will probably be the biggest update the game will receive, as I'm going to be moving onto other projects. I will still be releasing bug fixes for any bugs that get reported to me, though.

We're hitting some big-time patch note territory here, y'all. (Why did I say that...?)

Anyway, here are the patch notes.

Menus:

- Fixed a bug where you could open the menu during the intro credits.
- Fixed a bug where the text that would appear when deleting a save file would appear in the wrong location.
- Added a secret that has a chance to appear after the intro credits and before the title screen.
- The intro credits creen now plays the noise from the trailer.
- Updated the copyright notice.

Dialogue:

- Cutscenes no longer repeat, for the most part.
- Rewrote some confusing dialogue. (Specifically, at the beginning with the first Trew you meet in the house, and with the cutscene in which you meet Yukina.)
- Fixed some typos.
- Added an interaction with the table and chair in the house you wake up in.

Navigation:

- The left stick on a gamepad can now be used to move the character. (Note that menus are still controlled with the D-Pad.)
- Fixed a bug where the music would restart in Yukina's house when going in between her house and kitchen.
- The way in which you go into a certain secret room has been altered.
- Added more stuff to that aforementioned secret room.
- Added a new easter egg.
- Fixed a bug where you couldn't go backwards in a certain room in Lareed.
- Added some more stuff to Smalland.
- Added a certain NPC to more areas of the game.
- A couple of rooms in the game have had their sizes and general layout altered. (Specifically, the room leading up to the arcade in Ardent, the arcade itself, the room with all the NPCs in Ardent, the room directly after the phone guy in the Field, and Smalland.)
- Fixed a bug where c'Raig's music could still play if you talked to him with music turned off.

General:

- The game can now be played with most Nintendo controllers.
(I tested this with an official Nintendo Switch Pro Controller, a knock-off one, a Wii U Pro Controller, and a Nitro Deck. I can't really test every single Nintendo controller, but I'm pretty sure it works with most ones people use for modern games. Note that if an Xbox controller and a Nintendo controller are plugged in at the same time, in most cases the game will prefer the Nintendo one.)

- The window size can now be adjusted. (Note that non-1:1 window sizes will cause the game to become pixel inconsistent and look bad. Also, pressing Alt+Enter will run the game in fullscreen.)

- Added a "wrong room" screen if your save file gets corrupted or if you're being a dirty hacker and your saved room ends up in a development-related room.

- Added a failsafe for losing battles.

- Added a little thingy that goes ring ring, and the consequences that would arise from the misuse of one.

- [strike]The game now contains 200% more jumpscares than it did before.[/strike]

notes.title: OMNIFATE is 54% off for my birthday (that's 69 cents!!!) + an update is coming!!
notes.content:
Hey. It's koola.

To celebrate my birthday, February 10th, OMNIFATE will be on sale for 54% off between February 9th-11th. That makes it 69 cents, which is a pretty nice price if I do say so myself.

Additionally, the big update I teased on the Lekooliatris Games Newsletter (which you can subscribe to at https://koola.substack.com ), is being delayed to an undetermined date. I have about 50-60% of it done right now, but life has been rather hectic for me lately so I don't want to promise anything. Toodles

notes.title: (Don't) Nominate OMNIFATE for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
The Steam Awards are here! You could nominate OMNIFATE for an award, but please don't. It has a 100% chance of failing because no one even knows about this game. You're better off just nominating a game that you really like and think should win an award. I don't even know of a good award for this type of a game.

But hey, if you do want to nominate OMNIFATE for an award, I won't stop you...
